resources.string: Set up once. Then jump straight into VR.

1. Copy your Xbox USA (NTSC-U) ZIP or 7z to the Download folder on your Quest. \n2. Select the archive below. Xbox ISO images inside it are unpacked automatically. \n3. Wait for the import to finish, then start the game.

Supports ZIP/7z containing default.xbe + NFSUNDER or one Xbox ISO, and ISO/XISO files directly. PC and European editions are unsupported. A disc import can take several minutes and need about 17 GB free in addition to the archive (about 5 GB for an archive of extracted game files). Existing saved games are kept.
Open “NFSU2 · Game data” to return here later. The normal game entry starts directly in VR.
The existing data will only be replaced after the new archive has been fully verified. Your saved games and settings will be kept.
Could not open the Android file picker. Restart your Quest, then open “NFSU2 · Game data” again.
Your existing game data and saved games will be kept.
